title: Sleek & Stylish condo with Shared Fitness Room
description:
Enjoy a sleek two-bedroom Nashville condo with city views, central air, and a full kitchen. The sleeping layout includes a king bed, a queen bed, and two single beds in the common area. Fast Wi-Fi, elevator access, a building gym, and nearby laundry make the space convenient for a downtown stay. Paid parking and limited street parking are available.

The space
Offering easy access to I-40, I-24, and all that Nashville has to offer, this sleek and contemporary, second-floor condo is a terrific option for a family vacation or couples retreat. When the weather is nice, roll up the bay door and allow the sunshine and fresh air to enter this unique condo. Brew up your morning coffee or prepare full-course dinners in the well-equipped kitchen, and then dine at the convenient island with counter seating for four. On lazy afternoons or in the evenings after exciting days out, take a seat on the leather sofa bed and stream your favorite channels on the TV. And on-site be sure to take advantage of the shared fitness room.

Shared Amenities・Rooftop lounge・Fitness center・Cornhole court・Elevator in the building

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.

Other things to note
